explanations.f707cec4-context_window-t1: A new session only includes the text sent in that request. Without the day-one text, the model has no access to the order number.
explanations.f707cec4-context_window-p1: The window is measured in tokens, and a single word can be split into several tokens. So a word count can understate the token count.
explanations.f707cec4-context_window-p2: Only text inside the window is usable, so sending the most relevant sections in pieces works within the limit. Relying on memory or assuming a fit does not.
